描述_EN: lots-o'-huggin' bear (lotso) for short is a character in the film toy story 3. unlike a lot of toy story characters who are based on real old toys such as mr potato head, lotso was invented just for this film. he is a plush, pink teddy bear with a big plum nose, a sweet strawberry scent and a southern accent. for advertising purposes some fake 1980s television advertisements were made by pixar, the company behind the film, in order to try and convince people that lotso was an old bear. as the leader of the toys at the sunnyside daycare center, he initially acts like a kind-hearted and wise caretaker, but is later revealed to be more of a ruthless warden, although his backstory makes him more of a tragic villain.
描述_ZN: lots-o'-huggin' bear（简称loto）是电影《玩具总动员3》中的一个角色。 不像很多玩具故事中的人物都是基于真正的老玩具，如土豆头先生，Lotuso是为这部电影而发明的。 他是一只毛绒绒的粉红色泰迪熊，有一个大梅花鼻子，有甜美的草莓香味，有南方口音。 为了广告目的，影片背后的公司Pixar制作了一些假的80年代电视广告，以试图说服人们Lotso是一只老熊。 作为sunnyside日托中心的玩具领袖，他最初表现得像一个心地善良和明智的看守者，但后来被发现是一个无情的监狱长，尽管他的背景故事使他更像一个悲剧性的反派。
